steps.en: Install the skill into your coding agent
steps.zh: 把 skill 装进你的编码 agent

steps.en: Point it at your product and say what the film is for
steps.zh: 告诉它产品是什么、这支片子给谁看
steps.code: Use video-shotcraft to create a promo for my desktop product.

steps.en: Checks the product read-only, maps shot cards, and storyboards the promo
steps.zh: 只读地看一遍产品，挑镜头卡，出分镜

steps.en: Writes Remotion compositions: 2.5D camera moves, captions, SFX on the beat
steps.zh: 写出 Remotion 组件：2.5D 运镜、字幕、卡点音效

steps.en: Render the film from the bundled template
Opens a workbench where shots can still be retimed and copy edited
steps.zh: 打开工作台，让你继续改镜头时长和文案

value.en: A cinematic product film from screenshots and one brief, with the shots still editable afterwards
value.zh: 一份截图加一句话，得到还能继续改镜头的电影感宣传片
